Meta.descripcion: Understand a Formula 1 session with real data: speed around the circuit, tyre wear and telemetry comparison.

Inicio.subtitulo: Analyze a Formula 1 session with real data and understand what happened on track.

Pie.aviso: Data from OpenF1. Independent project, not affiliated with Formula 1 or the FIA.

Estado.despertando: Waking up the server, it can take up to a minute…

Errores.tiempo_agotado: It took too long to respond.
Errores.sin_conexion: Could not connect to the server.
Errores.fallo_api: The server responded with an error.
Errores.parametro_invalido: Some value in the request is not valid.
Errores.analisis_no_disponible: This analysis is not available for that session.
Errores.telemetria_incompleta: The telemetry for that lap is incomplete.
Errores.piloto_no_encontrado: That driver was not found in the session.
Errores.sin_telemetria: There is no telemetry for that selection.
Errores.sesion_no_terminada: That session has not finished yet.
Errores.limite_peticiones: There are too many requests to OpenF1 right now. Wait a moment and try again.
Errores.fallo_openf1: OpenF1 is not responding properly. Try again in a while.
Errores.openf1_en_vivo: A live F1 session is in progress and OpenF1 blocks queries until it ends. Come back in a while.

Selector.indicacion: Choose a Grand Prix and a finished session to start.
